title.tr: Duvar dibinde tek kapaklı uzun beyaz dolap
title.en: Tall single-door white cabinet along a wall

alt.tr: Odanın köşesinde duvara yaslı, tek kapaklı, yerden tavana yakın beyaz boyalı dolap
alt.en: White painted tall single-door cabinet standing against the wall in the corner of a room

caption.tr: Dolap duvar hizasında duruyor ve kapağı düz, süssüz. Yanındaki panele ve prize dokunmadan yerleştirilmiş.
caption.en: The cabinet sits flush against the wall with a plain, flat door. It was fitted around the panel and socket beside it.
